luamade.script:
local function check(c, m) if not c then print("FAIL " .. m) error(m) end end
local p = console.getBlock().getPos()
local function at(dx, dy, dz) return vec3i(p.getX() + dx, p.getY() + dy, p.getZ() + dz) end

local ds = peripheral.wrapAt(at(1, 0, 0), "datastore")
check(ds ~= nil, "wrap datastore")
check(ds.getAccessLevel() == "entity", "access level")
check(ds.getStoreId() ~= nil, "store id")
for _, k in ipairs(ds.keys()) do ds.delete(k) end
ds.set("sensor/a", "1")
ds.set("sensor/b", "2")
ds.set("other", "3")
check(ds.getValue("sensor/b") == "2", "getValue")
check(ds.has("other") and not ds.has("missing"), "has")
check(#ds.keys("sensor/") == 2 and ds.size() == 3, "keys/size")
check(ds.delete("other") and not ds.delete("other"), "delete")
ds.set("sensor/a", nil)
check(not ds.has("sensor/a"), "set nil deletes")
print("PASS datastore")
